system.description:
Shield 30. Absorbs damage like a ship's shields, recharging 5 at the start of your turn; once knocked down it charges back up to half strength first. The battery lasts 1 minute (10 rounds); spare batteries weigh 10kg and take a minute to change. Switching it on or off isn't an action (not both in one round). While it's on: no pack, no Parry, no Fighting attacks, and switch it off to handle anything not on your person or squeeze through a gap under 120cm.

Espionage Supplement
